mediaEnabled.Name: Optimize files
mediaEnabled.Hint: Makes images, videos and sounds smaller so they load faster, with no visible loss. When off, the module does not touch any file.

optimizeUploads.Name: Optimize what gets uploaded
optimizeUploads.Hint: When anyone uploads an image, video or sound to Foundry, it is converted before it goes up and only the light version is kept. It applies to everyone, players included: the GM decides.

backfillMode.Name: Files the world already has
backfillMode.Hint: Automatic: converts everything the world already uses, little by little in the background, and points references at the light versions. Review first: lists what would be converted and only touches what you approve (Media tab of the dashboard). Don't optimize: leaves existing files as they are. Originals are kept; to empty them and free space, use the Cleanup tab.

keepResolution.Name: Keep image and video dimensions
keepResolution.Hint: Recommended. Only compresses, without shrinking dimensions, so nothing on the map gets misaligned. Turn off to shrink very large images and videos (limits under Advanced).

maxImageSide.Name: Largest image size (px)
maxImageSide.Hint: Only with "Keep dimensions" off. Images larger than this on their longest side are shrunk.

maxVideoHeight.Name: Highest video resolution
maxVideoHeight.Hint: Only with "Keep dimensions" off. Videos above this are shrunk.

imageQuality.Name: Image quality
imageQuality.Hint: Higher is more faithful and heavier. 0.85 shows almost no visible difference and saves a lot. Flat-colour maps are stored losslessly when that comes out smaller.

videoQuality.Name: Video quality
videoQuality.Hint: Medium works for nearly everything, animated maps included. High only if you notice lost detail.

videoStripAudio.Name: Remove sound from videos
videoStripAudio.Hint: Animated maps and scenes rarely need sound. Removing it makes the file smaller.

audioBitrate.Name: Music and sound quality
audioBitrate.Hint: 128 kbps already sounds very good for soundtracks and effects. Lower saves more; higher is for demanding ears.

skipMp3BelowKbps.Name: Leave MP3 below (kbps) alone
skipMp3BelowKbps.Hint: MP3 files that are already light stay as they are: converting would save almost nothing.

minSavingsPct.Name: Minimum saving (%)
minSavingsPct.Hint: If the new version is not at least this much smaller, the original is kept.

convertAnimatedGif.Name: Turn animated GIFs into video
convertAnimatedGif.Hint: Animated GIFs used as tiles or tokens become light videos with transparency. GIFs on sheets and portraits stay as they are.

includeCompendia.Name: Include the world's compendiums
includeCompendia.Hint: Also optimizes images and sounds stored in this world's compendiums. Module and system compendiums are never changed.

protectActiveScene.Name: Leave the scene in play alone
protectActiveScene.Hint: Files of the active scene and sounds playing now are only swapped once they are no longer in use, so nothing flickers during the session.

networkProfile.Name: How players reach you
networkProfile.Hint: Automatic figures it out and suits almost everyone. "Tunnel without CDN" is for a quick Cloudflare Tunnel link, ngrok or an open router port. "Behind a CDN" is for your own domain on Cloudflare with caching. Custom unlocks the network options under Advanced.

hostUploadMbps.Name: Your internet upload speed (Mbps)
hostUploadMbps.Hint: The UPLOAD speed of the internet connection hosting Foundry (check a speed test). Used so the connection never chokes during play.

preloadSharePct.Name: Share of upload for downloading ahead (%)
preloadSharePct.Hint: Custom profile only. How much of your connection may be used to fetch upcoming scenes early; the rest stays free for play.

maxConcurrentRequests.Name: Downloads at the same time
maxConcurrentRequests.Hint: Custom profile only. Limit of files downloading at once across all players. Free tunnels choke on too many.

staggerJoin.Name: Players join one at a time
staggerJoin.Hint: Custom profile only. When several join together, each loads the scene in turn instead of all fighting over your connection.

preloadEnabled.Name: Download upcoming scenes ahead of time
preloadEnabled.Hint: While nobody is loading anything, players download the scenes that come next. Scene changes become nearly instant.

idleSeconds.Name: Wait before fetching ahead (s)
idleSeconds.Hint: How long without any download before upcoming scenes start downloading.

preloadMaxFileMB.Name: Largest file to fetch ahead (MB)
preloadMaxFileMB.Hint: Files larger than this are only downloaded when used.

predecodeNext.Name: Prepare the next scene in memory
predecodeNext.Hint: Besides downloading, keeps the predicted next scene's images (the marked one; without a mark, its neighbour in the navigation bar or folder) ready in memory so the switch is instant. Uses more memory; only on computers with Medium performance or higher.

p2pEnabled.Name: Players share files with each other
p2pEnabled.Hint: Whoever already has a file sends it straight to the other players, sparing your connection. Needs HTTPS and the local cache; behind a CDN it is not used. Players who share see each other's IP address, and each one chooses whether to take part.

serviceWorker.Name: Keep files in the browser
serviceWorker.Hint: Each player keeps the light versions in their browser and does not download them again next session. Needs HTTPS (or localhost).

iceServers.Name: Connection servers (STUN/TURN)
iceServers.Hint: Addresses players use to find each other. The default works in most homes. Only change it if you know what a TURN server is.

p2pMinFileKB.Name: Smallest file to share (KB)
p2pMinFileKB.Hint: Smaller files always come from the server: opening a player-to-player connection is not worth it.

p2pTimeoutSec.Name: Wait for other players (s)
p2pTimeoutSec.Hint: How long to wait for another player before downloading the file from the server.

p2pParticipate.Name: Share files with the other players
p2pParticipate.Hint: Turn off on a limited connection. Players who share see each other's IP address; turning it off avoids that.

cacheQuotaMB.Name: Space for stored files (MB)
cacheQuotaMB.Hint: How much space stored files may take in this browser. The least used leave first when it fills up.

preloadScope.Name: How much to download ahead
preloadScope.Hint: Everything: the whole world, little by little. Only this session: what the session will likely need, never the rest of the world. Nothing: files download only when they are used. It starts lighter when the browser's data saver is on or on a mobile connection.

p2pUploadCapMbps.Name: Fastest sending to other players (Mbps)
p2pUploadCapMbps.Hint: Limits how much of your connection is used to send files to the other players. Keep it well below your upload speed, so voice chat and the game stay smooth.

Dashboard.Title: Optimal Foundry
Dashboard.GMOnly: Only the GM can open the Optimal Foundry dashboard.

Menu.Name: Optimal Foundry dashboard
Menu.Label: Open dashboard
Menu.Hint: Follow file optimization, the network and sharing between players, and choose what to preload.

Media.UndoAllConfirm: Every document goes back to its original file. Restored files will not be optimized again automatically (use "Optimize again" for that); new media follows the chosen mode (automatic, review first or don't optimize). Optimized files stay on the server (Foundry cannot delete files). Continue?
Media.Unavailable: Background optimization is unavailable (media turned off or failed to start; see the console).
Media.NotCoordinator: Only one GM session coordinates background optimization (the GM with the highest role, in the tab opened first). Controls are locked here.
Media.RetryFiltered: Retry the files in this list
Media.RetryFilteredConfirm: Retry {count} files? Restored files are optimized again and their references re-pointed; the others go back to the conversion queue.

Mode.auto: Automatic mode: everything the world uses is converted little by little, without asking.
Mode.review: Review first mode: nothing is converted without your approval. What waits for you is listed right below.
Mode.off: Optimizing existing files is off. Only what is uploaded from now on is optimized (if that option is on).

Media.WaitingWelcome: Nothing is converted until someone finishes the module's welcome screen.
Media.HeavyWaiting: {count} heavy file(s) wait for the players to leave: converting them now can slow this browser and the game. They are converted on their own once no player is connected.

Network.LocalHint: On localhost the CDN is measured by a connected player. Click Detect again with a player online.
Network.Unavailable: The network manager is unavailable (see the console).
Network.PreloadServing: Serving the queue (this browser does not preload)
Network.BudgetSlowed: Downloading ahead is slowed down right now ({rate} instead of up to {ceiling}): the connection is answering slowly ({rtt} ms), so the module leaves room for the game.

P2P.NoPeers: No direct connection to another player right now.

Preload.NextScenesHint: Mark a scene only if you want it before everything else, for example the next one in the session. You can also mark it from the Scenes tab's context menu. A scene leaves the list when it is activated.
Preload.RulesHint: "Always" goes to the front, along with what is likely. "Never" stays out of the queue.
Preload.Disabled: Preloading is turned off in the settings. The choices below are kept for when you turn it on.
Preload.AutoHint: The module decides on its own what each player downloads while the network is idle, most likely first: the scenes players are viewing, the rest of the active scene and its playlist, what is playing, the neighbouring scenes in the navigation bar and in the folder, teleport destinations, then the other scenes in the bar, the players' characters, and finally the rest of the world (the other scenes and playlists, hidden ones too, and the images of journals players can see). The bandwidth set aside for it, sharing between players and each browser's storage decide how far it gets. You do not need to mark anything.

TierHint.0: Marked scenes, the scene the GM is preparing and the scenes players are viewing.
TierHint.1: The rest of the active scene, what is playing, the neighbouring scenes, teleport destinations and what is in Always preload.
TierHint.2: The other scenes in the navigation bar, the playlists linked to the scenes above and the players' character art.
TierHint.3: The rest of the world: every other scene and playlist, even those players cannot see yet, and the images of journals they can see.

Reason.teleport: teleport destination of the active scene

Preload.NothingQueued: Nothing queued right now: everything the world uses is already planned or being converted.
Preload.NotCoordinator: The queue is built by the coordinating GM session. Open the dashboard there to see the prediction.

Notify.Unavailable: Optimal Foundry: this feature is not available right now.
Notify.ScanDone: Optimal Foundry: {paths} referenced files · {convert} to convert ({image} images, {audio} audio, {video} videos) · {rewrite} to re-point.

Scan.Title: What the world uses
Scan.Intro: Every media file the world uses (scenes, actors, items, journals, playlists and world compendiums), wherever it comes from: the world folder, modules, the system or Foundry itself. "Already light" means WebP, AVIF, Ogg and Opus: they are already in the final format, so there is nothing to convert. Hover the columns to see what each one means.
Scan.NotScanned: This world has not been scanned yet. Click Scan world.

OriginHint.module: Files from installed modules (modules/…). Optimized versions go to an optimal-foundry/ folder inside this world's folder, because a module's folder is replaced when it updates.
OriginHint.system: Files from the game system (systems/…). Optimized versions go to an optimal-foundry/ folder inside this world's folder.
OriginHint.core: Icons, sounds and images that ship with Foundry (icons/, sounds/, ui/…). Almost all are already WebP or Ogg.
OriginHint.data: Files in other Data folders, outside worlds/, modules/ and systems/ (for example an assets/ folder of yours).
OriginHint.otherWorld: Files stored in another world's folder that this world also uses.

OutcomeHint.optimized: They have an optimized version and the world uses it.
OutcomeHint.light: Already WebP, AVIF, Ogg or Opus. Nothing to do.
OutcomeHint.queued: Still to be converted, or converted with the reference not yet pointed at the optimized copy.
OutcomeHint.skipped: Left as they are; the reason is in the file list below (Skipped filter).
OutcomeHint.failed: Could not be converted after several attempts; see the Failed filter.
OutcomeHint.review: Not converted because they wait for your approval (Review first mode) or because optimizing existing files is off.

Scan.External: {count} file(s) live at another address (S3, a CDN or another site) and are not read: the module only converts files the Foundry server itself stores. Examples: {examples}
Scan.Vector: {count} SVG image(s) stay as they are: they are vector images and already light.
Scan.Packs: {packs} module and system compendium(s) ({documents} documents) are not read. They belong to the module or system and would go back to the original on its next update, so the module leaves them alone. What you import into the world (scenes, actors, journals) is read and optimized.
Scan.PacksAll: {packs} compendium(s) ({documents} documents) are not read, including the world's own, because "Include the world's compendiums" is off. Module and system compendiums are never read: they would go back to the original on the next update. What you import into the world is read and optimized.
Scan.Repaired: {count} reference(s) were pointed back at the original file, because the optimized copy was no longer on the server.

Review.Title: Waiting for your approval
Review.Intro: These files would be converted, and the scenes, sheets and journals that use them would point at the light version. Check what may be optimized. What you leave as it is no longer shows here (Try again, in the file list, brings it back).
Review.ApproveAllConfirm: Convert the {count} files in the list? References move to the light versions; you can undo from the file list or with Undo all.
Review.Approved: {count} file(s) approved; conversion starts in the background.
Review.Declined: {count} file(s) will stay as they are.

Reasons.tooLarge: too large to convert (too many pixels, or the converted file would not fit the upload limit)
Reasons.animatedGifImageField: animated GIF used as an image; kept
Reasons.missing: file not found on the server
Reasons.decodeError: the file could not be read
Reasons.restored: restored to the original by the GM; it will not be optimized again automatically
Reasons.interrupted: the conversion was interrupted (the browser crashed or closed)
Reasons.stalled: the conversion stopped making progress and was cancelled
Reasons.notPersisted: the library could not be saved; references were not changed
Reasons.workerStopped: background optimization stopped after an error
Reasons.uploadStopped: stopped after several uploads in a row failed
Reasons.declined: You chose to leave it as it is

Library.Finished: Background optimization finished: {done} converted, {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed.
Library.NotCapable: This browser cannot convert {kind}. Open the world in the Foundry app or in Chrome/Edge to optimize these files.
Library.UndoDone: Optimization undone: {reverted} files point to their originals again.
Library.UndoKept: {kept} files were not undone (the original is missing or an update failed). See the console.
Library.UploadFailed: Could not upload the optimized file to the server
Library.UploadTimeout: The server did not answer the upload in time
Library.UploadIncomplete: The optimized file did not arrive whole on the server
Library.UploadStopped: Background optimization stopped: {count} uploads in a row failed. Check the free space on the server's disk and the connection, then press Start in the dashboard.
Library.NotCapableInsecure: This page is not on HTTPS (nor on localhost), so the browser cannot convert files here. To optimize the files the world already has, open it through an https:// address, or through localhost on the server's own computer.
Library.Repaired: {files} optimized file(s) were no longer on the server. {references} reference(s) point at the originals again, and those files will be optimized again.
Library.UndoPaused: Background optimization is paused. Press Start in the dashboard to resume it.

Media.Converting: Optimizing {name}… Click to skip and upload the original.
Media.ConvertFailed: Could not optimize {name}. The original was uploaded.
Media.NotCapable: This browser cannot convert {name}. The original was uploaded and the GM will optimize it in the background.
Media.NotCapableInsecure: This page is not on HTTPS (nor on localhost), so the browser cannot convert {name}. The original was uploaded and the GM will optimize it in the background.
Media.UploadTooLarge: {name} is {size} MB. The Cloudflare tunnel limits uploads to 100 MB, so this upload may fail. Upload from the server machine or make the file smaller.

Reason.undecodable: The browser could not read the file
Reason.tooLarge: Too large to convert: the image has too many pixels, or the converted file would not fit the upload limit
Reason.noSavings: The optimized version was not small enough
Reason.lowBitrate: Low-bitrate MP3; converting is not worth it
Reason.missing: File not found on the server
Reason.noVideoTrack: The file has no video track
Reason.noAudioTrack: The file has no audio track
Reason.audioNotEncodable: The video's audio could not be converted
Reason.animatedGif: Animated GIF kept as-is on upload
Reason.animatedGifImageField: Animated GIF used in an image field; kept as-is
Reason.animatedGifDisabled: Animated GIF conversion is turned off
Reason.loopLength: Looping sound kept as it is: the converted copy would click each time the loop restarts

Network.WaitingTurn: Waiting for your turn to load the scene (position {position} in the queue).

Cdn.Found: A CDN that keeps the files was found (test result: {status}). The automatic profile now uses it.
Cdn.NotFound: No CDN that keeps the files was found (test result: {status}). The automatic profile uses the limits of a connection without CDN.
Cdn.NoPlayer: Optimal Foundry: no player is online to measure the CDN. Try again with a player connected.
Cdn.ProbeFailed: Optimal Foundry: the CDN measurement failed. See the console.

Sw.Outdated: Optimal Foundry: the file optimal-foundry-sw.js in Foundry's Data folder is a copy from an older version of the module (v{version}, expected v{expected}). Replace it with the bridge file of the same name from the module's folder (Data/modules/optimal-foundry); after that, module updates need no new copy.
Sw.OutdatedServer: Optimal Foundry: the local cache is still running an older version (v{version}, expected v{expected}) and the server offered no newer one. Reload the page; if this message comes back, the server or a CDN in front of it is still handing out an old modules/optimal-foundry/sw.js.

Preload.GMOnly: Only the GM can mark upcoming scenes.

SwReason.insecure: The local cache needs HTTPS (or localhost).
SwReason.unsupported: This browser cannot keep a local cache.
SwReason.scopeDenied: The local cache could not start: the module's bridge file is not in Foundry's Data folder.
SwReason.notFound: The local cache could not start: the module's file was not found on the server.
SwReason.notActive: The local cache was installed but did not start in time. Reload the page.
SwReason.error: The local cache failed to start. See the console.

SwarmReason.disabled: Sharing is turned off in the module's settings.
SwarmReason.cdn: The game is behind a CDN, which already delivers the files quickly, so players do not send files to each other.
SwarmReason.notChosen: You have not chosen yet whether this browser shares files with the other players. Until you do, it stays out.
SwarmReason.optOut: You turned sharing off in this browser.
SwarmReason.noWebRTC: This browser cannot open direct connections to other players.
SwarmReason.noCrypto: This browser cannot check the files it would receive.
SwarmReason.noCache: The local cache is not active in this browser, and sharing needs it.
SwarmReason.error: Sharing failed to start. See the console.
SwarmReason.local: This browser runs on the server's own computer, so it stays out of sharing on purpose: what it sent would use the server's own connection.

FailReason.iceTimeout: the two browsers found no direct path to each other in time (often a strict router or network)
FailReason.failed: the direct connection could not be made
FailReason.error: the browser refused to open the connection

Connection.Title: My connection

Menu.Name: My connection
Menu.Label: Open
Menu.Hint: See how this device loads the game (local cache, sharing with the other players, downloading ahead) and change its own options.

Connection.OptionsHint: Saved in this browser only; other players and the GM are not affected.
Connection.ClearCacheConfirm: Delete the optimized files saved in this browser? They are downloaded again when needed.
Connection.CacheNotEnabled: The game master has not turned on the local cache on this server yet. Until then, files are downloaded again each session and players cannot share them.
Connection.NotChosen: You have not answered this browser's first questions yet. Until you do, it shares nothing with the other players.

Cleanup.Intro: Originals the module already replaced with optimized versions still take up space. Foundry does not let modules delete files, so the cleanup empties each original: the file stays in its folder under the same name, but becomes 0 bytes and stops taking space. Only files in this world's folder qualify: already converted, mentioned by nothing this world loads (scenes, sheets, journals, macros, chat, settings, every compendium, the system's and the active modules' too, and the descriptions of the world, the system and the modules; token art picked by a name pattern counts as in use), and with an intact optimized version. What the check cannot see: other worlds on this server, compendiums of modules that are turned off, and macros that put a file name together while they run. If any of those uses files from this world's folder, do not empty them.
Cleanup.NotAnalyzed: Click Analyze to look for originals that can be emptied.
Cleanup.None: No original can be emptied right now.
Cleanup.InUse: {count} still in use in the world
Cleanup.OutsideWorld: {count} outside the world folder or not checkable
Cleanup.BrokenCopy: {count} with a missing or different optimized version
Cleanup.Confirm: Empty {count} original(s) and free {size}? Scenes, sheets and playlists keep using the optimized versions. Each file is checked again before it is emptied.

Reason.copySize: optimized version size does not match
Reason.copyHash: optimized version content does not match
Reason.uploadFailed: the server refused the empty file
Reason.unknownSize: the server did not report the size
Reason.uncertain: could not confirm it was emptied; marked as emptied to be safe
Reason.missing: not found on the server; nothing was changed
Reason.notCoordinator: not reached: another GM session took over the optimization

Error.UndoRunning: An undo is running. Try the cleanup again when it ends.
Error.NotCoordinator: Only the GM session that coordinates optimization can run the cleanup.
Error.Compendium: Could not read the compendium {pack}, so nothing was emptied ({error}).

Cleanup.NotCoordinator: The cleanup only runs in the GM session that coordinates optimization (the GM with the highest role, in the tab opened first). The buttons are locked here.
Cleanup.Lead: Empties the originals already replaced, to free space. It cannot be undone, and other worlds on this server are not checked.
Cleanup.ConfirmOtherWorlds: Other worlds on this server are not checked. If another world uses one of these files, it will be broken there.
Cleanup.ConfirmNoUndo: This cannot be undone: each file becomes 0 bytes, its content cannot be recovered, and Undo no longer applies to it.

Config.Title: Optimal Foundry: settings

Menu.Name: Settings
Menu.Label: Open settings
Menu.Hint: Pick a preset or adjust what the module does in this world. Only the GM sees and decides; it applies to every player.

Config.Intro: Start with a preset. It only fills in the form: nothing changes until you click Save. These choices apply to the whole world; each player adjusts only their own device in "My connection".

recommended.Name: Recommended
recommended.Hint: Balance between quality and speed. Suits almost everyone.

saver.Name: Maximum saving
saver.Hint: Weak connection or many players. Much lighter files, with some quality loss.

quality.Name: Maximum quality
quality.Hint: Light compression. For good connections and the most detail.

networkOnly.Name: Leave files alone
networkOnly.Hint: Keeps every file as it is and uses only the network features.

custom.Name: Custom
custom.Hint: The current values match no preset.

Config.AdvancedHint: Technical options. The defaults suit almost everyone; only change them if you know what you are doing.
Config.NeedsReload: Changing this reloads Foundry for everyone.
Config.WelcomeUnsaved: Some changes here are not saved yet. Save them and open the welcome screen?

Tracker.Hide: Hide (bring it back from the Tokens controls)

Media.WaitingWelcome: Waiting for you to choose how the module works.
Media.Waiting: Waiting for the network to be free · {queued} queued
Media.HeavyWaiting: {count} heavy file(s) waiting for the players to leave

State.unknown: No information (preloading off on that device, or it has not asked yet)

Tracker.PlayersOtherGM: Players show up in the coordinating GM session.
Tracker.PlayersHint: The bar shows how much of what comes next each player already has: the scenes someone is viewing, the active scene, its neighbours and what is playing. Hover a player for details.
Tracker.AllReadyNotice: Optimal Foundry: every player already has what {scene} needs.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Optimal Foundry
Welcome.Intro: The module makes the game lighter: it converts images, videos and sounds to smaller formats, downloads ahead what players will need and lets players share files with each other. Choose below how it works in this world. You can change everything later in the module's settings.
Welcome.PresetHint: How much to compress. Recommended changes nothing you can see.
Welcome.ModeHint: Converting what already exists changes the references in scenes, sheets and journals. Originals are kept and it can be undone.

review.Name: Review first
review.Hint: The module lists what would be converted and only touches what you approve, in the dashboard.

auto.Name: Automatic
auto.Hint: Converts everything little by little in the background, without getting in the way of the game.

off.Name: Leave them
off.Hint: Existing files stay as they are.

Switch.optimizeUploads: Images, videos and sounds uploaded from now on go up light, from anyone.
Switch.preloadEnabled: Each player downloads ahead, while the network is idle, the scenes, playlists and images they will need. You do not need to mark anything.
Switch.p2pEnabled: Players pass files to each other, easing the host's internet connection.

Welcome.UploadHint: How much the internet of whoever hosts Foundry can send (upload speed). The module uses it so the connection does not choke.
Welcome.TrackerHint: A small panel, GM only, with what is being optimized and whether each player already has what comes next. Drag it, collapse it or hide it; it comes back from the Tokens controls.
Welcome.Outro: Until this screen is finished, no existing file is converted. Downloading ahead already runs with the defaults; sharing starts for each player once they choose it.
Welcome.LaterNotice: Fine. The screen comes back the next time you enter; until then, no existing file is converted.
Welcome.Done: Done! Optimal Foundry is set up.
Welcome.Lead: Choose how the module works in this world. You can change everything later.
Welcome.KeepCurrentHint: The current quality values match no preset. Without picking a preset, they stay as they are.
Welcome.OutroShort: Nothing is converted until you click Start.

Card.off: Existing files stay as they are.
Card.optimizeUploads: New uploads go up already light.
Card.preloadEnabled: Players get the next scenes early.
Card.p2pEnabled: Players pass files to each other.
Card.tracker: A small status box over the map.

Setup.Title: One step left: turn on the local cache
Setup.Missing: The local cache (and sharing between players) cannot start until one small file of the module, the bridge file, is in Foundry's Data folder.
Setup.Stale: The file optimal-foundry-sw.js in Foundry's Data folder is from an older version of the module and must be replaced by the new one.
Setup.How: Copy the file optimal-foundry-sw.js from the module's folder (Data/modules/optimal-foundry) into the Data folder itself, next to the modules and worlds folders, replacing the file if it is already there. Then click Check again.
Setup.WhereNote: These are the usual places. If you chose another folder when installing Foundry, or use a hosting service, look for the folder that holds modules and worlds.
Setup.Done: Optimal Foundry: the local cache is on.
Setup.StillMissing: Optimal Foundry: the file was not found yet. Check that optimal-foundry-sw.js is in the Data folder itself, with exactly that name.
Setup.StillStale: Optimal Foundry: the file in the Data folder is still the old one. Replace it with the one from the module's folder.

Blocker.insecure: This page is not on HTTPS (nor on localhost), so the browser does not allow converting files, the local cache or sharing between players here. Downloading ahead and the network control still work. To use everything, open the world through an https:// address, or through localhost on the server's own computer.
Blocker.unsupported: This browser cannot convert files. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or the Foundry app.

Blocker.https: the page is not on HTTPS
Blocker.cache: the local cache is not active there
Blocker.local: on the server's own computer, kept out on purpose
Blocker.choice: turned off there, or the player has not chosen yet

Sharing.Title: Sharing between players
Sharing.Intro: A player who already has an optimized file sends it straight to the others, which spares the host's upload. Every file is checked before it is used. A browser on the server's own computer never takes part.
Sharing.OffSetting: It is turned off in the module's settings.
Sharing.OffCdn: Behind a CDN it is not used: the CDN already spares your connection, so players would gain nothing from sending files to each other.

Why.https: The players' page is not on HTTPS, and sharing needs it.
Why.cache: The local cache is not active in the players' browsers, and sharing needs it.
Why.choice: The players turned it off, or have not chosen yet (each one is asked the first time they enter).
Why.local: The players are on the server's own computer, so they stay out on purpose.

FirstRun.Title: Your connection in this game
FirstRun.Lead: Choose how this browser takes part in this game. You can change it later in My connection.
FirstRun.ShareTitle: Share files with the other players?
FirstRun.ShareYesLine: Files you already have go straight to the others, and theirs to you.
FirstRun.ShareNoLine: Everything comes from the game's server.
FirstRun.ShareIp: Players who share see each other's IP address.

Scope.all: The whole world, little by little.
Scope.off: Files download when they are used.

FirstRun.Outro: On a mobile or limited connection, prefer the lighter options.
